test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

I receive a lot of ________ from my family members, who are very encouraging.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'inspiration****'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us see the meanings of the given words: 
 
 
• Inspiration: someone or something that gives you ideas for doing something (कोई व्यक्ति या कुछ जो आपको कुछ करने के लिए विचार देता है)
 
• **Ambition:** a strong wish to achieve something (कुछ हासिल करने की प्रबल इच्छा)
 
• **Expectation: **the feeling that good things are going to happen in the future. (यह भावना कि भविष्य में अच्छी चीजें होने वाली हैं।)
 
• **Invitation:** the act of inviting someone to go to an event (किसी कार्यक्रम में जाने के लिए किसी को आमंत्रित करने की क्रिया)
 
 
 
• From the meanings of the words, we can say that 'inspiration' is the most appropriate answer.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is 'inspiration.'

 

The correct sentence__: *I receive a lot of** ****inspiration** from my family members, who are very encouraging.*
